ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a parallelogram WXYZ, with vertex W at the upper left, X at the upper right, Y at the lower right, and Z at the lower left. The interior angle at point W is labeled 105°, the right side XY is labeled 24, and the bottom side ZY is labeled 28. What is required is ∠WZY, that is, the interior angle at point Z formed by ZW and ZY. Reasoning: Because WXYZ is a parallelogram, adjacent interior angles are supplementary. ∠W and ∠WZY are adjacent interior angles, therefore m∠WZY = 180° - 105° = 75°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: WXYZ is drawn as a parallelogram with W at the upper left, X upper right, Y lower right, and Z lower left. The angle at W is labeled 105°, and the requested angle WZY is the interior angle at Z between ZW and ZY. From the question text, use the fact that the quadrilateral is a parallelogram. In a parallelogram, consecutive interior angles are supplementary because opposite sides are parallel. Angles W and Z are consecutive, so m∠WZY = 180° − 105° = 75°.
